008b_initial.finding: Background Work could read and review GitHub but direct mutation of agent-lab/state.json was rejected as too risky without explicit approval.

verified_capabilities: dormant Work can wake and reconstruct an active orchestration attempt from GitHub
dormant Work can independently inspect a Cursor implementation commit
dormant Work can independently inspect GitHub Actions
dormant Work can write low-risk durable transition evidence to GitHub
dormant Work can return a terminal result into the same persistent Work conversation
active orchestrator can reconcile a dormant transition ledger into authoritative state
authoritative state.json need not be writable by dormant Work
architecture_decision: Use per-attempt transition ledgers for dormant background mutations. Treat state.json as an authoritative compacted projection reconciled by the active orchestrator.
remaining_boundary: The Work monitor pauses after terminal processing and must be re-armed or lifecycle-managed for subsequent tasks. Immediate webhook wake-up also remains unproven.
